I'm adding one new file, `tests/test_issue_templates.py`. It needs no production code. I have only seen `bug.md`, so I'm assuming the other three templates carry the same marker comments (`<!-- triage: begin -->` / `<!-- triage: end -->`). The test will say so if they don't.

<edit path="tests/test_issue_templates.py">
import re
from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".github" / "ISSUE_TEMPLATE"
TEMPLATES = ["bug.md", "feature.md", "question.md", "docs.md"]

TRIAGE_BLOCK = re.compile(r"<!-- triage: begin -->.*?<!-- triage: end -->", re.DOTALL)


def triage_blocks(template_dir):
    """Map template name -> list of triage blocks found (line endings normalised)."""
    blocks = {}
    for name in TEMPLATES:
        text = (template_dir / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
        blocks[name] = TRIAGE_BLOCK.findall(text)
    return blocks


def find_drift(template_dir):
    """Return names of templates whose triage block is missing, duplicated,
    or different from the first template's block."""
    blocks = triage_blocks(template_dir)
    reference = blocks[TEMPLATES[0]]
    return [
        name
        for name in TEMPLATES
        if len(blocks[name]) != 1 or blocks[name] != reference
    ]


def test_triage_blocks_are_identical_across_issue_templates():
    drifted = find_drift(TEMPLATE_DIR)
    assert not drifted, (
        f"triage block differs from {TEMPLATES[0]} (or is missing/duplicated) in: {drifted}"
    )


def test_find_drift_flags_a_template_whose_block_changed(tmp_path):
    block = (
        "<!-- triage: begin -->\n**Priority:** p3\n**Area:** unsorted\n"
        "**Assignee:** triage-bot\n<!-- triage: end -->\n"
    )
    for name in TEMPLATES:
        (tmp_path / name).write_text(block + f"\nbody of {name}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert find_drift(tmp_path) == []

    (tmp_path / "docs.md").write_text(
        block.replace("p3", "p1") + "\nbody of docs.md\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    assert find_drift(tmp_path) == ["docs.md"]
